g.title: AANAT
g.text: ↑ at night, acutely suppressed by light

g.title: PRC
g.text: evening light = delay · dawn light = advance

g.title: ONSETP
g.text: σ( wS·S + C(t) − A − θ + Σ drug effects )

g.title: SPRESS
g.text: saturating rise in wake · exponential decay in sleep

g.title: BETAEEG
g.text: intrudes at sleep onset and during NREM

g.title: LOCSLP
g.text: sensory and motor cortex asleep while
prefrontal and limbic regions stay awake

g.title: MDD
g.text: insomnia is both a risk factor and a residual symptom

g.title: DMN
g.text: fails to deactivate at sleep onset

g.title: CORT
g.text: characteristically raised evening and night nadir

g.title: PREDIS
g.text: trait anxiety · rumination · female sex · family history

g.title: PERPET
g.text: (the real target of drugs and CBT-I)

g.title: TIBext
g.text: 'if I lie there longer I will sleep more'

g.title: DBAS
g.text: 'if I do not get 8 hours tomorrow is ruined'

g.title: SAFEBEH
g.text: self-medication with alcohol · early bedtime · compensatory caffeine

g.title: STIMC
g.text: bed only when sleepy · the 20-minute rule

g.title: CYP3A4
g.text: CL↓ in the elderly and in women (~50% in women)

g.title: ESZc
g.text: t½ ≈ 6 h (9 h in the elderly)

g.title: DORAAE
g.text: daytime sleepiness · sleep paralysis · hypnagogic hallucinations

g.title: RAMM2
g.text: 1/10 the MT affinity but a large total contribution

g.title: MELdose
g.text: (approved in Europe for ≥55 years) · IR 0.5–5 mg

g.title: DOXc
g.text: anticholinergic action only at high doses

g.title: CAFdose
g.text: half-life 5 h (↑↑ in pregnancy / on OCs)

g.title: EXERC
g.text: afternoon exercise: SWS↑ / just before bed: arousal↑

g.title: TEMPB
g.text: peripheral vasodilatation → promotes the CBT fall

g.title: PSYCHO
g.text: (FDA 2013 lowered the zolpidem dose for women)

g.title: REBOUND
g.text: arousal overshoot for 1–3 days after stopping

g.title: DEPEND
g.text: hard to taper after long-term use
